gloss_en: the tzaddikim (righteous ones) insofar as they are also called 'brit shalom' (covenant of peace, per Numbers 25:12) — the righteous as embodiments of the covenant of peace, through whom one finds God in both good fortune and adversity (Likutey Moharan I:33)
canonical_he: צדיקים שנקראו גם כן ברית שלום
